updates.why: 2026-11-12: on the rail vehicle a GPS denial reaches the Shield as the rails realise it - EKF3's dead-reckoned estimate (sweep_scenarios GPS_DROPOUT_MODELS 'dead_reckoned', RAIL_EKF_DRIFT_MPS 0.23 m/s measured against SITL's SIMSTATE on 30 hil denials) - not the frozen last fix no rail hands it; docs/RUBRIC-failsafe.md section 8, '2026-11-12'

backstop_rule.rule: a run in which the autopilot took the aircraft to RTL or LAND on a fence breach while the FSM held in Brake or Loiter is a fail-safe triggered by the backstop (failsafe_by autopilot_geofence), scored against the label like any other trigger
backstop_rule.before: such a run was left out as censored where the FSM held in Loiter with its operator timeout pending, and scored as not triggered where it held in Brake
backstop_rule.decided: 2026-11-15 by the lab under the PI's instruction of 6 Oct (follow the grant; best practice where it is silent); the PI's confirmation is still to be recorded
